'''Maciej Zworski''' {{post-nominals|country=CAN|FRSC}} (born 8 October 1963) is a [[Poland|Polish]]-[[Canadians|Canadian]] [[mathematician]], currently a professor of mathematics at the [[University of California, Berkeley]]. His mathematical interests include  [[microlocal analysis]], [[scattering theory]], and [[partial differential equations]].

He was an invited speaker at [[International Congress of Mathematicians]] in Beijing in 2002,<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.mathunion.org/db/ICM/Speakers/SortedByLastname.php |title=ICM Plenary and Invited Speakers since 1897 |access-date=2011-12-18 |archive-date=2017-11-24 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171124141541/http://www.mathunion.org/db/ICM/Speakers/SortedByLastname.php |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref>{{cite journal |author=Zworski, M.|title=Quantum Resonances and Partial Differential Equations |journal=Proceedings of the ICM, Beijing |volume=3 |pages=243–254|arxiv=math/0304400|bibcode=2003math......4400Z |year=2003 }}</ref> and a plenary speaker at the conference Dynamics, Equations and Applications in [[Kraków]] in 2019.<ref>[https://www.dea.agh.edu.pl/plenaryspeakers DEA 2019 Plenary Speakers]</ref><ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=84jI1KBhn6Q Maciej Zworski's plenary lecture]</ref>

Zworski and Semyon Dyatlov are the recipients<ref>{{cite web | title=News from the AMS  - Joseph L. Doob prize | website=American Mathematical Society | date=10 November 2025| url=https://www.ams.org/news?news_id=7556 | access-date=2025-11-10}}</ref> of the 2026 Joseph L. Doob prize, for their 2019 book ''Mathematical Theory of Scattering Resonances''.<ref>{{cite book | last1=Dyatlov | first1=Semyon | last2=Zworski | first2=Maciej | title=Mathematical Theory of Scattering Resonances | publisher=American Mathematical Society | publication-place=Providence, Rhode Island | volume=200 | date=2019 | isbn=978-1-4704-4366-5 | doi=10.1090/gsm/200 | url=http://www.ams.org/gsm/200 | access-date=2025-11-10 }}</ref><ref>{{cite journal | last=Baskin | first=Dean | title=Book Review: Mathematical theory of scattering resonances | journal=Bulletin of the American Mathematical Society | volume=58 | issue=3 | date=2021-02-25 | issn=0273-0979 | doi=10.1090/bull/1714 | doi-access=free | pages=475–477 | url=https://www.ams.org/journals/bull/2021-58-03/S0273-0979-2021-01714-9/S0273-0979-2021-01714-9.pdf | access-date=2025-11-11}}</ref>
